# Tube2Blog

> Free YouTube to blog converter: paste any YouTube URL and get an AI-written SEO blog post in seconds. Extract transcripts, generate metadata, export Markdown. The easiest video to blog post generator for creators.

## Core Tool
- [YouTube to Blog Converter](https://tube2blog.com): Paste a YouTube URL, get an AI-written SEO blog post in seconds
- [Features](https://tube2blog.com/features): Transcript extraction, AI writing, metadata generation, Markdown export
- [Dashboard](https://tube2blog.com/dashboard): Manage your converted posts
- [Pricing](https://tube2blog.com/pricing): Free and paid plans
